text:
katie: Observing a flurry of `unexpected end of stream` + okhttp STREAM_CLOSED when running the Kotlin sample upload flow on Android emulator (api 28/29). Physical devices fine.

katie: Setup: Retrofit multipart upload -> /v1/upload, auth interceptor that can refresh token synchronously. Happens during heavy test runs or when emulator network is saturated.

sanjay: guess: emulator NAT/proxy closes pooled connections earlier; combined with blocking token refresh + non-replayable RequestBody leads to retries that can't be replayed.

jonah: two quick mitigations we tried: 1) make auth refresh use a dedicated OkHttp client with connectionPool(0,1,TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS) + short callTimeout; 2) ensure upload RequestBody is rewindable or disable automatic retry for upload calls. Both reduced flakes significantly.

lee: repro snippet for rewindable helper: ```kotlin
class SmallBufferedBody(private val bytes: ByteArray, private val mt: MediaType?) : RequestBody() {
  override fun contentType() = mt
  override fun contentLength() = bytes.size.toLong()
  override fun writeTo(sink: BufferedSink) { sink.write(bytes) }
}
```

marta: note on UX: buffering isn't acceptable for large files. We should document resumable uploads or instruct SDK users to manage retries at the application layer for large payloads. Also add an SDK-level flag to refuse automated retry for non-replayable bodies by default.

sanjay: proposal: introduce Request.tag("replayable") or an extension isReplayable() so retry logic checks it. Also add opt-in `enableRetryForNonReplayable` config (default false).

jonah: small sample for auth client: ```kotlin
val authClient = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .connectionPool(ConnectionPool(0,1,TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS))
  .callTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(30))
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(false)
  .build()
``` Use this client inside Authenticator to do refreshes so we don't block pooled connections.

katie: added a minimal repro branch in samples repo and wired a flaky emulator CI job. Link (internal). ciara-bot started the matrix run.

ciara-bot: CI queued for branch katie/emulator-upload-repro : emulator (api28, api29) upload tests.

marta: docs action items: 1) FAQ entry "Why do I get STREAM_CLOSED on emulator?" with bullet workarounds; 2) sample auth-client and buffered-body snippet; 3) recommend `adb reverse` for local dev to avoid emulator NAT. I'll open a docs PR.

jonah: additional diagnostic: when we see STREAM_CLOSED during an Authenticator/Interceptor refresh, log the presence of non-replayable body + request method; that will help users find the cause faster.

sanjay: agree. For SDK change, I will draft a short RFC for retry semantics and add tests that run on emulator CI matrix to detect regressions.

katie: assigning myself to follow up with PRs: samples, small SDK tweak, and docs. Will mark emulator CI job flaky if nondeterministic. Thanks. :thumbsup:
